description: Get branch split counts and post-step cohort conversion rates for every branch, condition, and action step in a sequence, plus a baseline across all enrollments. Answers 'how many people took each path' and 'what % of people who took path X or reached step Y converted within N days' (works for non-email and holdout branches too). Pass goalId (a goal ID or 'default-revenue') or eventName (mutually exclusive); omitting both auto-selects when the sequence has exactly one active automation-scoped goal and otherwise returns counts only plus availableGoals. Important interpretation rules: (1) rule-based if/else splits are observational (causal: false) because the rule selects different audiences; (2) when comparing paths, use matureConverted / matureEntrants so recent enrollments still inside the conversion window do not bias rates; (3) random splits report causal: true and significance on the mature cohort, noting that re-enrolled contacts are re-randomized; (4) for goal outcomes, attributed conversions are scoped to the selected goalId and can differ from the all-goals canvas email badges.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

conversionWindowDays.description: Conversion window in whole days after reaching the step (1 to 90, default 7). Truncated early if the contact re-enrolls at the same step.

end.description: ISO 8601 end of cohort arrival window; send start too.

eventName.description: Custom event name to measure post-step conversion against (e.g. 'saas.upgraded'). Mutually exclusive with goalId.

goalId.description: Goal ID to measure conversions against, or 'default-revenue'. Mutually exclusive with eventName.

nodeIds.description: Optional list of node IDs to scope the response to.

period.description: Rolling window ending now selecting cohorts by arrival time: 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, or 90d. Omit for all-time cohorts.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID from list_sequences or get_sequence.

start.description: ISO 8601 start of cohort arrival window; send end too (max 90 days).

name: get_sequence_path_stats

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_sequence_path_stats` MCP tool.

availableGoals.description: Active company and sequence-scoped goals plus default-revenue that can be passed as goalId.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

baseline.description: Baseline cohort conversion metrics across all enrollments of this sequence.

branches.description: Branch and condition nodes with per-path entrants, share, converted, conversionRate, trackedValue, matureEntrants, matureConverted, matureConversionRate, causal flag, per-goal attributed rollup (can differ from all-goals canvas badges), and random-split significance.
